Before you travel.

Which airports do you serve?

Héline First provides airport assistance at Paris–Charles de Gaulle and Nice Côte d’Azur. Contact us to discuss your itinerary and requested services.

Can you assist on both arrival and departure?

Yes. Our services cover arrival, departure and connections. Your assistance is prepared around your journey.

How do I arrange a welcome?

Prepare a request with your airport, travel date and relevant details. Our team will contact you to discuss the services and confirm the arrangements. A request is not a confirmed reservation.

What happens if I cannot make my connection?

If a delay makes your connection impossible, our teams can help with the formalities for arranging the next available flight.

Are your hosts multilingual?

Our hosts are multilingual. Please mention your preferred language in your request so we can prepare appropriate assistance.

Can you also arrange a stay or event?

Yes. Héline First offers hospitality services, event hosts and the coordination of tailored stays, delegations and events.
